_readme: ALL text on skillededge.io/chatbot and ALL demo-chatbot answers come from this one file. See HOW-TO-EDIT.md. Keep it valid JSON: every text in double quotes, a comma between items, no comma after the last item in a list.

aiMode._note: Future switch. Leave false. The demo answers only from the FAQ below. Turning this on needs a new /api/chatbot-demo.js function plus AI Gateway billing; it does nothing today.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: What happens to the visitor who shows up at 9 p.m.?
problem.text: Homeowners look for help when something breaks, which is often after hours or while your team is on a job. If your site only says "call us," some of them call the next company on the list. The assistant gives them answers right away and takes their callback request, so you can follow up first thing.

safety.label: Safety & AI disclosure
safety.title: Built to stay in its lane.

items.title: Only your approved info
items.text: It answers from info you approve. If it doesn't know, it offers a callback instead of guessing.

items.title: No prices or advice
items.text: No prices unless you give them to us in writing. No diagnosis, repair or DIY advice, no guarantees, no "deals."

items.title: Emergency words first
items.text: Gas smell, carbon monoxide, sparks, smoke or flooding get a fixed message: leave the building if unsafe, call 911 or the gas company, then your phone number. This message doesn't come from the AI.

items.title: Labeled as AI
items.text: It says it's an AI assistant in the header and first message. Visitors see that chats are recorded and shared with your business.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.text: You own your customers' chats and can get a copy anytime. AI providers' no-training settings are on. We never sell lead data. Transcripts are deleted after 12 months.

salesFaq.q: What does the chat assistant do?
salesFaq.a: It's an AI chat assistant that sits on your shop's website. It answers common questions (services, hours, service area, how to book) from info you approve, takes callback requests and emails them to you, and handles emergency words like gas smell or sparks with a fixed safety message. It won't quote prices you haven't approved, diagnose problems or give repair advice.

$300 one-time setup plus $249 a month. That covers setup from your website, hosting, AI costs, leads emailed to you, up to 3 answer updates a month and a short monthly summary. It's month-to-month with no long-term contract. Pricing is the same for every shop, so I can't offer discounts or custom terms.

After you sign up you fill out a 5-minute setup form. We build the assistant from your website and send you a private preview within 2 business days of receiving your form. You approve the answers, then paste one line of code on your site.

salesFaq.q: Do I own the chat data?
salesFaq.a: Yes. You own the chats your customers have with your assistant. You can ask for a copy anytime and we'll send it as a spreadsheet within 10 business days. We never sell lead data, the AI providers' no-training settings are on, and transcripts are deleted after 12 months. We may use anonymized, combined data across all shops to improve the service, with no shop's customers identifiable.

Yes. It's month-to-month with no long-term contract. The cancellation notice terms are in the Service Agreement you accept at checkout, and the assistant switches off when service ends. The $300 setup fee is non-refundable once work begins.

salesFaq.q: What happens if a customer mentions a gas leak or other emergency?
salesFaq.a: Emergency words (gas smell, carbon monoxide, sparks, smoke, flooding) are checked before anything else. The customer gets a fixed message: leave the building if unsafe, call 911 or the gas company, then your phone number. That message doesn't come from the AI, so it can't be reworded or skipped.

salesFaq.q: Can it give repair advice or diagnose problems?
salesFaq.a: No, on purpose. It refuses to diagnose problems or walk customers through repairs, and it won't give DIY, code or permit advice. Instead it offers a callback so your team handles it. Try the sample shop mode above and ask it "why is my AC blowing warm air?" to see the refusal.

salesFaq.q: Will it make up prices or promises?
salesFaq.a: It's set up to refuse. It only quotes prices you give us in writing, and it won't make guarantees, promises or "deals." Anything it can't answer from your approved info becomes a callback request instead of a guess.
No. It's an AI assistant and it says so up front, in the chat header and the first message. Visitors are also told the chat is recorded and shared with your business.

salesFaq.q: How do I get the leads?
salesFaq.a: By email, to the address you choose: name, phone, email and the customer's issue. There's no app to log into. It doesn't send texts or connect to phone systems.

salesFaq.q: Do I need a web developer to install it?
salesFaq.a: No. You paste one line of code. We include step-by-step instructions for WordPress, Wix, Squarespace and GoDaddy, or you can forward the email to whoever manages your site. We send a test lead so you know it works.

salesFaq.q: What if it gets something wrong?
salesFaq.a: Tell us and we fix it. Up to 3 answer updates a month are included, and you approve every change. It's labeled as an AI assistant that can make mistakes, and nothing it says is a quote or binding offer.

salesFaq.q: Does it work with ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro or my phones?
salesFaq.a: Not today. Leads come by email only. It doesn't connect to CRMs, scheduling software, phones or text messaging.

salesFaq.q: Which trades and areas do you work with?
salesFaq.a: It's built for HVAC, plumbing and electrical shops. Skilled Edge Group is based in Springfield, VA. If you're not sure your business is a fit, request a free demo and we'll tell you honestly.

salesFaq.q: Can I see it on my own website first?
salesFaq.a: Yes. Request a free demo below with your website, and we'll build one from it on a private link that expires in 7 days. No payment info needed.
There's a short Service Agreement you accept at checkout. It's month-to-month. It covers what the assistant will and won't say, safety handling, data ownership and cancellation.
Skilled Edge Group LLC in Springfield, VA, run by Dave Hahn. Email dave@skillededge.io.
